tools.name: metric_search
tools.description: Search account metrics by Graphite-style pattern (e.g. foo.bar.*).

tools.name: busy_metrics
tools.description: Return the busiest metric in the account and its rate-limit percentage.

tools.name: invalid_metrics
tools.description: Return invalid metrics rejected by Hosted Graphite parsers.

tools.name: delete_metrics
tools.description: Delete all metrics matching a Graphite-style pattern (e.g. test.*).

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Create a Hosted Graphite alert (supports composite alerts via additional_criteria and expression).

tools.name: search_alerts
tools.description: Search alerts by name, id, or free-text search string.

tools.name: get_alert
tools.description: Get details for a single alert by id.

tools.name: update_alert
tools.description: Update one or more fields on an alert. Only specified fields are changed.

tools.name: delete_alert
tools.description: Delete an alert by id.

tools.name: mute_alert
tools.description: Mute an alert for the given number of minutes.

tools.name: unmute_alert
tools.description: Unmute an alert by id.

tools.name: get_alert_mute_status
tools.description: Get mute status and scheduled mutes for an alert.

tools.name: mute_alerts
tools.description: Mute multiple alerts by id list or search string. Mutes all alerts if both are omitted.

tools.name: unmute_alerts
tools.description: Unmute multiple alerts by id list or search string. Unmutes all alerts if both are omitted.

tools.name: get_alert_history
tools.description: Get alert trigger/recovery history, optionally filtered by alert id and other fields.

tools.name: create_notification_channel
tools.description: Create a notification channel (email, slack, pagerduty, webhook, victorops, opsgenie).

tools.name: search_notification_channels
tools.description: Search notification channels by type, description, or id. Returns all if filters are omitted.

tools.name: get_notification_channel
tools.description: Get details for a single notification channel by id.

tools.name: update_notification_channel
tools.description: Update one or more fields on a notification channel. Only specified fields are changed.

tools.name: delete_notification_channel
tools.description: Delete a notification channel by id.

tools.name: create_scheduled_mute
tools.description: Create a scheduled mute. repeat days are mon–sun; omit for a one-time mute.

tools.name: search_scheduled_mutes
tools.description: Search scheduled mutes by name, id, duration, start_time, timezone, or repeat day.

tools.name: get_scheduled_mute
tools.description: Get details for a single scheduled mute by id.

tools.name: update_scheduled_mute
tools.description: Update one or more fields on a scheduled mute. Only specified fields are changed.

tools.name: delete_scheduled_mute
tools.description: Delete a scheduled mute by id.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all tag names in the account. Optionally filter by name and limit results.

tools.name: search_tag_values
tools.description: Search values for a tag name (e.g. host with filter=prod-00*).

tools.name: find_tagged_series
tools.description: Find tagged series matching tag expressions (e.g. cluster=prod).

tools.name: delete_tagged_series
tools.description: Delete tagged series by path (e.g. foo.bar;tag1=val1;tag2=val2).

tools.name: create_dashboard
tools.description: Create a new Grafana dashboard.

tools.name: list_dashboards
tools.description: List Grafana dashboards.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Get a single Grafana dashboard by uid.

tools.name: update_dashboard
tools.description: Update an existing Grafana dashboard by uid.

tools.name: delete_dashboard
tools.description: Delete a Grafana dashboard by uid.

tools.name: render_graphite
tools.description:
Query Graphite render API for metric data or graph images.

    Uses the MCP token against /mcp/graphite/render on the API host.
